You can tell a Catalyst candidate by the signs   They are 4X4 signs framed with PVC piping.  They are mass-produced by Catalyst and they all look alike.
See Catalyst vets the candidates and then points them to campaign donors - most of them are developers, bankers, and real estate folks.  They then donate to their campaigns.  The campaigns then pay Catalyst.  See how it works?  Like the Triangle Trade.
The politicians do NOT care about the current residents - just the future residents.
This is why Baldwin County is getting so crowded - THANKS TO CATALYST CANDIDATES AND POLITICIANS.
These politicians have sold their souls to the developers when they ran for office.
The results are already in! SUCKERS!

This is absolutely crazy that the same people, election cycle after election cycle, get voted in time and time again. Hoss Mack was awesome when he first was voted in. Then he tried to rig the election by getting a law passed that you had to have a degree or som many years of experience in law enforcement before being elected sheriff. Luckily the courts saw through that and changed it. Then there is Elliot and Simpson. Please tell me what is it they actually do? There’s Gruber, who’s been sitting on the commission for the last 30 years. Again, why isn’t there another candidate to replace his forgetful self. Then there are the mayors: Craft, Keenon, Wilson, Murphy, Wilks…and so on. And the next big election will be for sheriff. More of the same with Lowery, who is another extended Hoss, but way worse. At least Hoss had some calming sense ability to him. Lowery is just in it for himself. He managed to piss off half his work force before even announcing his run. The real appointee would have been the Andre Reed guy if he hadn’t gotten himself caught with his pants down around his ankles. Let’s move on to the the local city councilmen, like in Foley, Summerdale, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, Fairhope. They all sit their butts in there for years and just smile and wave. I believe Robertsdale is the only city that has a complete new set of people running for every position. Could it be that they break the cycle of all the same folks? Baldwin county needs new leadership in every position. Make a change in county, city, sheriff.
It is not a democracy when they let us vote and switch the vote totals out and show us the same ole same ole winners. It's fixed like a tuna sandwich.

Well I see we kept the same ole bully mayor in Orange Beach and Gulf Shores. We got rid of  King Wilson in Summerdale, and King Murphy and Wilks in Robertsdale and Bay Minette. Maybe now some new ideas will come in for those areas. Now to get rid of Hoss Mack 2.0 and kick Lowery out with someone who wasn’t a part of an establishment, we may be able to give others with a vision a chance.

Catalyst is like pu##y... 

STILL undefeated!

Well, the good old boy system strikes again. Evidently Sheriff Lowery was given a bunch of money to push a criminal narrative to help out the Alabama agricultural commissioner elect. He basically funded his entire campaign by pulling strings and favors
Robertsdale has a new council and  a mayor run off. One candidate that has been in politics for 4 years and the other for 12.  One with ties to Hoss and one without.  Should be interesting

Why did Sheriff Lowery receive campaign money from a victim of a crime before and after he took a personal interest in the case by hand picking the people and prosecutor who would handle the case? A misdemeanor crime victim turned campaign contributor who happens to be running for an elected position.
